## About
MSI Automotive has been working on cars in San Rafael and Marin County for a long time. Curtis Cronin bought the shop and built it around reliable work at fair prices, and today he runs it with a team of ASE-certified technicians.
We work on foreign and domestic vehicles, including hybrid and diesel models, and we are a State of California Licensed Smog Check Test & Repair center. The shop is also Diamond Certified and Star Certified.
One reviewer called us the cleanest shop in town and has had us look after a diesel Ram and vintage sports cars. Whether it's an oil change or a Check Engine light that won't go off, bring it by and we'll take a look.

## Services
- Tune-ups, oil changes and brakes: Tune-ups, oil changes, brakes, shocks and struts.
- Electrical diagnostics and engine repair: When your car's electrical system acts up, we track down the cause and handle electrical engine repair.
- Timing belts, clutches and transmissions: Timing belts, clutches, transmissions and wheel alignment.
- Smog checks: Smog checks at our State of California licensed test and repair center.

## FAQ
Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Friday, 7:30 AM to 5:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Do you work on my make?
A: We work on Subaru, Ford, Honda, Audi, Lexus, Volkswagen, BMW, Chevy, Toyota and more. Give us a call if you don't see yours.

Q: What happens if my car fails smog?
A: We have the tools to repair it here and can get your vehicle to pass inspection.
